MAIN_SUBSCRIPTION_DESCRIPTION: Subscription mode is active. Finding the best location downloads locations from the remote source and updates the saved list.
MAIN_SAVED_LOCATIONS_DESCRIPTION: Saved locations are active. Finding the best location tests the locations saved on the Locations tab.
PROXY_CONNECT_DESCRIPTION: Start or stop the local mixed proxy
FIND_BEST_SUBSCRIPTION: Find the best location from the subscription
FIND_BEST_SAVED: Find the best location from saved locations
MISMATCH_TITLE: Selected location is from a different subscription
MISMATCH_ACTION: Run Find Best or reconnect to switch to a location from the current subscription.
PROFILE_DESCRIPTION: Choose where the app gets locations from. Use a remote source in subscription mode, or work only with the saved list from the Locations tab.
STATS_DESCRIPTION: Session data and recent status history are shown here.
SETTINGS_LANGUAGE_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: Use the system language by default, or choose a language for VPN Control only.
DNS_APPLIES_NEW_DESKTOP_SESSIONS: Applies to new desktop proxy or VPN sessions.
APP_MODE_ANDROID_DESCRIPTION: Default mode is VPN. Turn on Proxy Only to run a local HTTP/SOCKS mixed proxy instead of Android VPN.
APP_MODE_DESKTOP_DESCRIPTION: VPN mode uses sing-box TUN on Linux or Windows. macOS currently supports Proxy-only mode until a privileged helper is implemented.
APP_MODE_ANDROID_PROXY_DETAIL: Local mixed proxy mode is enabled. Turn it off to use Android VPN mode.
APP_MODE_ANDROID_VPN_DETAIL: Android VPN mode is enabled. Turn on Proxy Only to expose a local mixed proxy instead.
APP_MODE_ANDROID_VPN_FOOTER: VPN mode routes traffic through Android VpnService.
APP_MODE_DESKTOP_VPN_DETAIL: Turn off to use only the local proxy.
APP_MODE_DESKTOP_PROXY_DETAIL: Turn on to route desktop traffic through VPN/TUN mode.
APP_MODE_DESKTOP_CHANGE_WARNING: Changing mode while connected stops the current session first.
REFRESH_DESCRIPTION_ALL: Works only when Profile Source is set to Subscription. The app will periodically redownload every saved subscription and update the merged locations list.
REFRESH_DESCRIPTION_SELECTED: Works only when Profile Source is set to Subscription. The app will periodically redownload the selected subscription and update the saved locations list.
REFRESH_DESCRIPTION_DESKTOP: While the desktop app is open, it can periodically redownload {0} and update cached locations.
REFRESH_POLICY_OFF_DESCRIPTION: Do not update subscriptions in the background.
REFRESH_POLICY_CUSTOM_DESCRIPTION: Use a custom interval in hours. Minimum 5 minutes.
FIND_BEST_AFTER_REFRESH_DESCRIPTION: When already connected, rerun best-location search after a background refresh finishes.
KEEP_CURRENT_LOCATION_AFTER_REFRESH_DESC: Background refresh only updates subscription caches and does not rerun best-location search.
CUSTOM_INTERVAL_HELP: Examples: 0.5 = 30 minutes, 1.5 = 1 h 30 min. Minimum 5 minutes.
VALIDATION_DESCRIPTION_ALL: The app uses these sites when testing locations. In All mode it checks the fastest locations from every saved subscription in batches: top N first, then the next N, until the secondary site works.
VALIDATION_DESCRIPTION_SELECTED: The app uses these sites when testing locations. In subscription mode it checks the fastest locations from the selected subscription in batches: top N first, then the next N, until the secondary site works.
VALIDATION_DESCRIPTION_DESKTOP: Find best uses these sites when testing locations from {0}.
VALIDATION_ANDROID_SUMMARY: Concurrency matches the current batch size, up to 5. Retry count reruns the whole search if no usable location is found. Current settings: {0}
VALIDATION_DESKTOP_SUMMARY: Concurrency matches batch size, up to 5. Current: {0}
QR_TOO_LARGE_MESSAGE: This {0} export is {1} bytes and is too large for a reliable single QR code. Use Clipboard or File instead.
LOCATIONS_DESCRIPTION_SUBSCRIPTION: Location search uses the remote source saved on the Profile tab. This list is updated from it each time.
LOCATIONS_DESCRIPTION_SAVED: Location search uses the saved locations below. No subscription is required.
NO_LOCATIONS_CACHED: No locations cached yet. Find the best location in subscription mode to load them, or add your own.
NO_SAVED_LOCATIONS: No saved locations yet. Add one manually or switch back to subscription mode.
TAP_EDIT_TO_FIX_LOCATION: Tap edit to fix this location
NAME: Name
RENAME_SUBSCRIPTION_HELP: Leave it empty to use the detected name again.
LOCATION_CONFIG_HELP: Paste a vless://, trojan://, ss://, vmess://, or socks:// link, a stored location JSON object, or a full sing-box JSON config. Remote source links belong in Profile Source on the Profile tab.
PROFILE_SOURCE_DESCRIPTION_SUBSCRIPTION: Subscription mode is active. Finding the best location uses the active subscription below and its cached locations.
PROFILE_SOURCE_DESCRIPTION_SAVED: Saved locations are active. Finding the best location tests the locations saved on the Locations tab.
PROFILE_SOURCE_USE_SAVED_HINT: Turn off to use the locations saved on the Locations tab.
PROFILE_SOURCE_USE_SUBSCRIPTION_HINT: Turn on to use the subscription URL.
SUBSCRIPTION_URL_PLACEHOLDER: Paste a subscription URL or import link
SUBSCRIPTION_URL_HELP: Paste a subscription URL or a remote import link.
DESKTOP_SUBSCRIPTION_URL_HELP: Desktop currently supports direct https:// subscription URLs here.
ALL_SUBSCRIPTIONS_DESCRIPTION: Merge locations from every saved subscription and search across all of them.
DESKTOP_SHELL_DESCRIPTION: This desktop target persists its workspace, supports file and clipboard import-export for locations and routing rules, refreshes direct https subscriptions, and starts sing-box in Proxy-only or desktop VPN mode.
PROFILE_SOURCE_DESKTOP_USE_SAVED_HINT: Turn off to work only with locations saved on the Locations tab.
PROFILE_SOURCE_DESKTOP_USE_SUBSCRIPTION_: Turn on to use subscription-backed locations.
ROUTING_DESCRIPTION_DESKTOP: Choose domains that should go direct instead of through VPN/proxy.
ROUTING_DESCRIPTION_VPN: Choose which apps use the VPN and which domains go direct. If Ignore Rules is off and no apps are assigned, all apps use VPN.
ROUTING_DESCRIPTION_PROXY: Choose which domains go direct when using proxy-only mode. App assignments are still saved for VPN mode.
APP_ASSIGNMENTS_DESCRIPTION_VPN: While Ignore Rules is off, assigned apps use VPN; if none are assigned, all apps use VPN. Direct-domain rules still apply.
APP_ASSIGNMENTS_DESCRIPTION_PROXY: Saved for VPN mode only. Proxy-only mode does not support per-app routing.
COUNTRY_CODE_DOMAINS_DESCRIPTION: One per line. Traffic for these country domains goes direct, without VPN/proxy. Example: ru
BYPASS_DOMAINS_DESCRIPTION: One per line. Traffic to these domains goes direct, without VPN/proxy. Example: magnit.com
IGNORE_RULES_ON_DOMAINS_ONLY: Ignore rules is on. Domain rules are saved but not applied.
IGNORE_RULES_OFF_DOMAINS_ONLY: Ignore rules is off. Domain rules are active.
IGNORE_RULES_ON_APPS: Saved app assignments and domain rules are ignored. Normal app traffic goes through the VPN.
IGNORE_RULES_OFF_APPS: Assigned apps use the VPN. If no apps are assigned, all apps use the VPN. Saved domain rules are applied.
IGNORE_RULES_ON_PROXY: User-defined domain rules are ignored. Proxy-only mode sends all proxied traffic through the selected connection.
IGNORE_RULES_OFF_PROXY: User-defined domain rules are applied. App assignments stay saved for VPN mode.
RESTART_VPN_AFTER_RULES: Restart the VPN after saving or importing rules.
RESTART_PROXY_AFTER_RULES: Restart the local proxy after saving or importing rules.
APP_ASSIGNMENTS_HELP: Turn apps on to limit VPN to those apps. Leave empty to route all apps through VPN.
NO_APPS_MATCH: No apps match the current search.
APPS_NOT_LOADED: Installed apps have not loaded yet.
PROXY_ONLY_RULES_DESCRIPTION: Only domain rules apply in proxy-only mode. App assignments are kept for when you switch back to VPN mode.
LOCAL_PROXY_DESCRIPTION: Use this local mixed proxy in apps that support HTTP or SOCKS proxies.
PROXY_STATUS_RUNNING: Status: proxy is running on this address
